tool_args.rationale: The pilot ends at H=0.48, whereas the target is H=21.8. A slow-horizon observation directly constrains the adaptation and possible reversal identified by the authorized mechanism guidance.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon rows cannot reliably identify the slow adaptation timescale or long-horizon reversal.
Fine short-time sampling is less directly informative about the target horizon.
It does not resolve the temporal-mechanism ambiguity.
